title: fix(cli)!: docs/nav-target judges each package body's navigationContributions on a multi-package artifact
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuVpEmthvkRbuHGjC6oSQZvd)_

Fixes #27343

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — on a multi-package `composeStacks(…, { manifest: 'preserve' })` artifact, a `type: 'doc'` item in a package body's `navigationContributions`, whose `doc` or `book` names nothing the artifact carries, built clean before and is now refused by `os build`, `os validate` and `os lint` (`docs/nav-target`).
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md` (the `type: 'doc'` nav section) and `content/docs/ui/apps.mdx` (the `docs/nav-target` paragraph) already teach the refusal with no single-package limit; this change makes contributions on multi-package artifacts meet that text.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:`os build`/`os validate`/`os lint` 的文档导航检查(`docs/nav-target`)在多包产物上改为逐包读取各包自己的 `navigationContributions`(只改 `packages/cli/src/utils/collect-docs.ts` 的 `lintDocNavTargets` 一处读取)。
- **为什么改**:多包 `preserve` 产物的顶层 manifest 只是"最后一个包"(主包)的副本,其他包贡献到别的应用里的文档导航项从没被检查过,指向不存在文档的条目会静默通过构建、到运行时才坏。
- **风险与回滚**:一次收窄(BREAKING,`minor`):多包产物里"非主包贡献的导航项指向不存在文档"从静默通过变为构建错误;单包应用不变,主包的贡献只判一次不重复报。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`packages/cli/src/utils/collect-docs.ts` 中 `lintDocNavTargets` 的 `contributions` 一行;`packages/cli/src/utils/collect-docs.nav-target.test.ts` 新用例;`.changeset/27343-doc-nav-target-package-contributions.md`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/utils/collect-docs.nav-target.test.ts`,预期 10 个用例全部通过。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`lintDocNavTargets` read `navigationContributions` off the artifact's top-level manifest only. Measured on a real two-package `preserve` composition (`composeStacks([svc, crm], { manifest: 'preserve' })`):

| Who contributes | Top-level `manifest.navigationContributions` | `packages[i].manifest.navigationContributions` | Issues before |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| first package (`svc`, non-owner) | absent | `packages[0]` only | 0 |
| last package (`crm`, owner) | present (the owner's copy) | `packages[1]` | 1 |

The contributions now come from each package body when the stack carries `packages[]`, otherwise from the top-level manifest. The walk is the same `artifactPackages(stack)` the function already uses for books and apps; no second walker.

**Why not "top level when present, else bodies" (the card's wording).** Falsified by the table: when the owner contributes, the top level carries its copy, so that rule would still skip every other package's contributions. Reading the top level as well as the bodies would judge the owner's twice. The rule here is the one `collectNavGroupInputs` (`packages/cli/src/utils/nav-contribution-groups.ts`) already applies to the same key for the same reason.

## Tests

One new case in `collect-docs.nav-target.test.ts`, on the real composer:

- the top-level manifest carries no `navigationContributions` when only the non-owner contributes;
- a resolving doc passes;
- a dead doc in the non-owner's contribution is refused at `apps/setup/navigation/nav_svc_help`;
- when both packages contribute a dead doc, exactly two issues come back, one per package (the owner's top-level copy is not judged a second time).

## Acceptance notes

- **Narrowed population.** A hand-written artifact that carries `packages[]` and puts contributions on its top-level manifest that no body carries is no longer judged there. The runtime registers each `packages[]` entry's own manifest (ADR-0130 D4), so such a top-level copy is not what gets registered; `collectNavGroupInputs` makes the same call.
- **Declaration lines** follow the dispatch: `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`, so the changeset is `minor` with a BREAKING banner and the ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` disposition. The claim comment carries the bare `Clause-②: no`; the narrowing arm is from triage and the dispatch.
- No in-tree example's `navigationContributions` carries a `type: 'doc'` item (the dogfood battery below is green).

## Verification

Final head `6c5250cbd` (origin/main `28872e68d` merged in). The unit tier, typecheck and the first gate run are at `260fe77e0`, before that merge; the merge touches none of the three changed files. The dogfood battery, the gate re-run and the target test re-run are at `6c5250cbd`.

- After it: `Tests 10 passed (10)`.
- Ablation at `91e14b22` (fix committed first), through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: anchor `const contributions = (bodies.length > 0` replaced with `const contributions = (false` (the old top-level-only read). Anchor x1 to x0, replacement x0 to x1, blob `f64208d1cd06` to `edd969ecd1bb`. Run: the new case fails with the same `expected [] …` assertion, `Tests 1 failed | 9 passed (10)`.
